breakdown.description: Each CCD direction is paired with the opposite direction's `PROCAR` file instead of its own matching file.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification repeated the error from the incomplete prompt. It explicitly pairs v_Ga/ccd_0_-1 vaspruns with PROCAR from v_Ga/ccd_-1_0/1/PROCAR, and v_Ga/ccd_-1_0 vaspruns with PROCAR from v_Ga/ccd_0_-1/1/PROCAR (cross-pairing). The ground truth requires each CCD direction to be paired with its own matching PROCAR file (same directory's 1/PROCAR). The code confirms this error: `procar_for_0m1` loads from `ccd_-1_0` and `procar_for_m10` loads from `ccd_0_-1`, which is the opposite of what the ground truth specifies.
